# Creative Boom

> > Creative Boom is a leading online magazine covering design, branding, advertising, and the creative industries, featuring studio work, industry news, and professional advice for creatives.

Founded and edited by Katy Cowan, with contributors including Abbey Bamford and Tom May, Creative Boom showcases brand identity projects, rebranding campaigns, design inspiration, and practical guidance for freelancers and creative professionals worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Brand identity and rebranding
- Graphic design
- Advertising campaigns
- Packaging design
- Creative industry news
- Freelance business advice
- Client relationships
- Typography and visual language
- Photography and illustration
- Tourism and place branding
- Storytelling in design
- Design studios and agencies
- Creative events and conferences
- Sustainable and responsible design

- [Mother Design gives soda challenger Fhirst a 'wild expression of joy'](https://www.creativeboom.com/news/mother-design-gives-soda-challenger-fhirst-a-wild-expression-of-joy): Mother Design creates maximalist brand identity for Fhirst probiotic soda
- [How Studio Kiln built an esports brand that behaves like its audience](https://www.creativeboom.com/news/how-studio-kiln-built-an-esports-brand-that-behaves-like-its-audience): Studio Kiln builds authentic Fellowkids esports brand embracing fandom culture
